research.title: Negation Sensitivity in Sentiment Classification
bullets: Designed controlled comparisons of lexical and transformer classifiers using sentiment examples with matched negation edits and unchanged topic vocabulary.
Analyzed prediction changes across negation scope and sentence structure, separating polarity errors from failures on ambiguous expressions.

research.title: Domain Transfer in Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Designed experiments comparing direct transfer and supervised adaptation of entity taggers across news articles and technical support text.
Analyzed span boundary errors and entity type confusion, examining how vocabulary overlap and annotation conventions affected transfer behavior.

research.title: Confidence Calibration for Intent Classification Under Domain Shift
bullets: Designed experiments evaluating temperature scaling and confidence thresholds for intent classifiers under shifts in vocabulary and user phrasing.
Analyzed reliability diagrams and selective prediction curves, comparing calibration behavior across intent frequency groups and manually reviewed error categories.

publications.title: Confidence Calibration and Selective Prediction for Intent Classification Under Vocabulary Shift

work.title: Support Text Processing and Search Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned updates to text normalization and document indexing components used to retrieve internal support articles.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and duplicate records, and investigated retrieval defects using application logs and reproducible examples.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Extractive Summarization Methods
bullets: Implemented frequency-based and graph-based sentence ranking methods for extractive summarization, using shared preprocessing and document length constraints.
Compared summaries with reference texts using lexical overlap metrics and manual checks for redundancy, coverage, and sentence coherence.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Question Matching
bullets: Implemented lexical retrieval and sentence embedding baselines for matching incoming questions to a collection of previously answered questions.
Compared ranking quality under identical candidate pools, inspecting failures involving paraphrases, rare terminology, and questions sharing misleading keywords.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling for Keyphrase Extraction
bullets: Implemented conditional random field and recurrent neural sequence taggers for keyphrase extraction with consistent tokenization and evaluation splits.
Compared exact span precision and recall, examining disagreements involving multiword terms, nested phrases, and keyphrases absent from training examples.
